note: Previously unused official public no-login source window. Planning Data Border contains the single ONS England boundary; the official entity is statistical-geography:E92000001 (England). This gives an exact official identifier and boundary geometry, but the fixed future_growth_3 owner/partition/checkpoint contains no authoritative evidence binding this slot to all England, E92000001, or any subordinate LPA/local-plan/LAD geography. Treating the England border as this slot's coverage area would therefore invent partition ownership and could falsely imply all-England completion. No coverage_area_id is bound to the slot, no source-area record is accepted, no parcel is accepted, and no Plan0 package is emitted.
